title: Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf
text: Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / 5 Why Reddit built its own AI prototyping tool | Blair Metcalf 🎙️ Reddit’s principal UX engineer shows how a custom Figma MCP and Cursor pipeline takes any designer from blank slate to shareable, production-shaped prototype in minutes—no Git required Claire Vo Oct 26, 2026 5 Share Transcript Blair Metcalf is the principal UX engineer at Reddit and the builder of Reddit Proto, the company’s in-house vibe-coding harness. With a design system MCP that maps Reddit’s product language to production code, Proto has reached 100% adoption across Reddit’s UX and product org, and more than 700 prototypes are live on it. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts What you’ll learn: Why Reddit built its own prototyping harness How designers share prototypes with leadership safely Why real Reddit data beats mock data How one annotation becomes a code edit in Cursor What a “feature capsule” is Why Blair built a “Rosetta stone” Blair’s surprising fix when AI goes sideways Who turned out to be Reddit’s best prototypers This entire episode is brought to you by: Firecrawl —Give your AI agents web data and beyond In this episode, we cover: ( 00:00 ) Introduction to Blair ( 02:31 ) Reddit Proto demo ( 09:15 ) Annotations to Cursor: the targeted edit workflow ( 11:19 ) Internal deployment and adoption ( 14:14 ) How leadership reviews and gives feedback ( 15:52 ) Engineering handoff and the feature capsule ( 17:50 ) How the custom MCP was built ( 21:41 ) Quick recap ( 24:55 ) Lightning round and final thoughts Tools referenced: • Cursor: https://www.cursor.com/ • Figma: https://www.figma.com/ • Figma MCP (Figma’s Model Context Protocol integration): https://www.figma.com/mcp-catalog/ • Code Connect (Figma’s code mapping tool): https://www.figma.com/developers/code-connect • Gemini: https://gemini.google.com/ • ChatGPT: https://chatgpt.com/ • Vercel (referenced as inspiration for internal deploy infra): https://vercel.com/ Other references: • Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/ • Kubernetes: https://kubernetes.io/ Where to find Blair Metcalf: LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jblairmetcalf Where to find Claire Vo: ChatPRD: https://www.chatprd.ai/ Website: https://clairevo.com/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/clairevo/ X: https://x.com/clairevo Production and marketing by https://penname.co/ .
